title: Qualifying Races – WSER
claims: The official qualifying-race list is updated each September and only listed events count as qualifiers.
Virtual events are not accepted as qualifiers.
The 2027 qualifying run must be completed between 3 November 2025 and 8 November 2026.

claimVerification.note: 首段写列表每年 9 月更新，只有列表内赛事有效。
页面明确不接受 virtual events。
2027 资格窗口与 Entry Process 页面一致。
